svg.text: CALIBRATION 0-100 mm: must measure 100.0 (+/- 0.5)
DRILL ⌀11.11 (7/16 in) through the vertical leg, 29 below the heel:
punch through the paper, 1/8 in pilot (dashed), then 7/16, low speed,
oil; deburr both faces.
On the bench, before the rails go on the tops. Hatched: rail B's end
on rail A. Grey: the fittings' legs and slots, orientation only.
RAIL A (P06) · vertical leg, OUTER face (toward the knee space) · HEEL edge UP · WALL END to the LEFT
TAPE LINE = 40.0 cm from the WALL END
CHECK = 62.0 cm
WALL END (x = 1 cm)
FAR END
INSIDE fitting heel 51.5
OUTSIDE fitting heel 52.0
(54.9 cm) A-out 1
(59.8 cm) A-out 2
RAIL B (P07) · vertical leg, EITHER face · HEEL edge UP · trim on the heavy END line, butt it flush with the CORNER END
RAIL A: 1. Trim on the heavy HEEL line. 2. Hook the tape on
rail A's WALL END (the end that goes 1 cm in from top A's
taped end) and mark 40.0 and 62.0 cm on the heel corner. 3.
Trimmed edge along the heel, TAPE line on 40.0; the CHECK line
must fall on 62.0 (if not, the sheet is scaled: reprint). 4.
Tape, punch, drill the four. Assumes rail B's outer face at 53
cm from the wall, butting on rail A (chapter H).
RAIL B: one bolt per hole with a fitting on both sides of the
leg, so the pattern is the same from either face. Skip if
already drilled. Bolts 3/8-16 x 1-1/2, washers, nylon nuts, 25
N·m by hand; never an impact wrench.
50 mm CROSS-CHECK
